event_name: FMP NHRA Arizona Nationals presented by NGK Spark Plugs

pairs.note:
Weather conditions: air temperature 99 degrees, relative humidity 10 percent, barometer 29.69 inches, adjusted
altitude 4,341 feet, track temperature 137 degrees.

This is the 2nd time that the #1 & #7 FC qualifiers have met in the Final round at this event. The #7 won in
2010.

Hyde and Capps have each won 2 times against the other in prior events and this is the first time they have
faced each other in a final round.

Capps with the starting line advantage and never trailed for the win.  He is straight down the groove with a
good looking pass for the win.  Capps wins his 78th National event Wally.

Hyde started to lose traction and clicked it off early.
